layout_type.description: Form layout: standard (all fields at once) or card_swipe (one field per card)

fields.description: Array of form field definitions. Each field is an object keyed by an `id` with a `type` and `label`. Boolean fields additionally support `default_value` (boolean), `flag_on_checkin` (boolean — when true and the form is event-linked, a truthy answer surfaces a warning on the QR check-in screen, check-in dashboard, and registration report), `flag_label` (string — the warning text shown to check-in staff; falls back to the field label when blank) and `flag_color` (string — one of `default`/`red`/`orange`/`green`/`blue`/`purple`/`pink`/`slate`; colours the flag banner/badge so check-in staff can tell different requirements apart; defaults to the amber warning colour).

redirect_url.description: Optional URL to redirect to after submission

require_authentication.description: Whether users must be logged in to submit

access_policy.description: Optional versioned audience policy. Version 1 stores group_rules (each with a tenant member-group id and optional canonical role_names), tenant RBAC role ids, and an 'and'/'or' operator between the group and RBAC dimensions. Missing, null, or empty policies are unrestricted.

is_active.description: Whether the form is currently active

deactivate_at.description: Optional scheduled deactivation timestamp (UTC ISO string). When set and in the past, the public form stops being served even while is_active is true. Null/empty means no scheduled deactivation.

deactivate_timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/London) used to display and interpret deactivate_at in the FormBuilder picker.

is_event_related.description: Whether this form is related to an event. When true, related_event_id points at the linked event and submissions carry that event reference.

allow_save_continue_later.description: Whether the public form offers the 'Save & Continue Later' button (save progress and get a resume link). Defaults to true so existing forms keep current behaviour; set false to hide the button while normal submission still works. Treat a missing value as true.

related_event_id.description: The single event this form is related to (Event id). Only meaningful when is_event_related is true.

owners.description: Array of member IDs who own this form. Owners get a scoped 'My Forms' tab on the FormSubmissions page showing only submissions for forms they own. Defaults to an empty list.

is_application_form.description: Whether this is an application form that requires uniqueness validation

is_job_posting.description: Whether this form is a job-posting application form. When true it appears in the member-group vacancy form picker so a vacancy can collect applications through it. For member pre-fill to populate, set prefill_source to 'member'.

application_level.description: For application forms: whether to check uniqueness at member or organization level

field_id.description: The ID of the field to check for uniqueness

check_mode.description: For email fields: full = entire email, domain_only = just the domain part

uniqueness_checks.description: Array of field IDs that must be unique in existing submissions or database records

auto_create_entity.description: For application forms: automatically create member/organization on submission (vs require admin approval)

source_field_id.description: ID of the form field to map from

target_type.description: Whether mapping to a core field, custom preference field, or an explicit member resource category. Resource-category mappings use target_field as the tenant resource-category ID and are valid only for member targets.

target_field.description: Name of core field or ID of custom field

transformation.description: Transformation to apply to the value

fallback_group.description: Explicit opt-in ordered fallback group. Mappings sharing an id and destination resolve the first visible, non-empty source.

field_mappings.description: Array of field mappings for application forms

entity_pipelines.description: Legacy rich Member and Organisation pipelines. The primary pipeline may include related_records entries with stable id, relationship_definition_id, and source_field_id; each entry links the exact primary pipeline result to submitted record-reference selections after persistence.

relationship_parent_field_id.description: For create/upsert relationship linking, the exact source-scope field containing the opposite endpoint record ID.

selector_field_id.description: For update_selected, the exact relationship_dropdown form field ID in the selected source scope. Its saved relationship_definition_id must equal relationship_definition_id.

structured_actions.description: Versioned Structured Record Actions. Each action runs against top-level answers or each row of one repeatable field and creates, updates a selected related record, or upserts a Member, Organisation, Organisation Group, or active Custom Object using stable relationship, object, form-field, and target-field IDs. Legacy entity_pipelines remain separate.

form_type.description: Form behaviour type. 'survey' enables Score fields, survey settings, versioning and server-side scoring; 'standard' forms are unchanged.

survey_settings.description: Survey-only settings: status (draft/published/archived, separate from is_active), intro_text, thank_you_message, response_identity (identified/anonymous/anonymous_dedupe), one_submission_per_respondent, show_progress, show_question_numbers, score_display (weighted/unweighted), reporting_scale, anonymity_threshold (default 3), current_version, parent_form_id.

survey_audit_log.description: Append-only audit entries for survey lifecycle actions: {at, actor, action (create/edit/publish/version/archive), detail}.
